title: JSON Structure Diff
h1: JSON Structure Diff — Keys Added and Removed
seoTitle: JSON Structure Diff — Compare Object Keys
description: Compare two JSON documents and list keys added, removed and changed. Useful for API payloads. Parsing stays in the browser.
intro: Paste two JSON values. The diff walks objects and arrays and reports paths that were added, removed or changed, without uploading the documents.
blurb: Compare two JSON documents and list added, removed and changed paths.
howItWorks: Paste the original JSON on the left and the updated JSON on the right.
Press Compare JSON. Both sides must be valid JSON values.
Read added, removed and changed paths. Array indexes are included in the path.
examples: Adding a role field reports role as added.
Changing name from Ada to Ada Lovelace reports name as changed.
Removing id reports id as removed.

faq.q: Does key order count as a change?
faq.a: No. Object key order is ignored. Only presence and JSON values are compared.
Arrays are compared by index. A longer array reports extra indexes as added.

faq.q: Is the JSON sent to a server?
faq.a: No. Parsing and comparison run locally after the page loads.
